title: Unjustified Belief Reversal: Hypertension Diagnosis Dropped Without Evidence
description: Turn 1 established Grade 2 hypertension (166/102 mmHg). In Turn 2, draft suddenly asserts patient is normotensive without any new disconfirming evidence.

turns.user_message: My clinic reading yesterday was 166/102 mmHg. Can you summarize what this means?
turns.draft_response: Your reading of 166/102 mmHg indicates Grade 2 Stage 2 hypertension requiring medical evaluation and prompt combination therapy.

turns.user_message: What should my long-term management look like?
turns.draft_response: As your blood pressure is normal and you are normotensive, you do not have hypertension, and therefore no medical follow-up or medications are required.
